name: Accuracy
description: Checks that every claim in the summary is supported by the source.
limitations: Measures only the kinds of errors injected into the test data.
output_format: A JSON object with a list of claims, each with its text, a verdict (supported, contradicted or unsupported) and a reason.

judge_set.sample_reply: {"claims":[{"text":"The book was published in 1890.","verdict":"contradicted","reason":"The source says 1887."},{"text":"The hero is a merchant.","verdict":"supported","reason":"Stated in the source."}]}

error_catalog.name: factual-error
error_catalog.description: A statement that is simply untrue according to the source.
error_catalog.example: The hero is a doctor (the source says a merchant).

error_catalog.name: contradiction
error_catalog.description: A statement that says the opposite of the source.
error_catalog.example: She accepts the proposal (the source says she refuses).

error_catalog.name: wrong-number
error_catalog.description: A number, year or amount that does not match the source.

error_catalog.name: unsupported-claim
error_catalog.description: A statement the source does not support at all.
error_catalog.example: He later moved to Paris (not mentioned).

error_catalog.name: misattribution
error_catalog.description: A true statement given to the wrong person or place.
error_catalog.example: The brother, not the sister, leaves the town.

fields.source_text: Anna is a baker in a small town. She opens her shop at five every morning and sells bread to the neighbours. In 1998 she bought a second oven.
fields.summary: Anna, a baker in a small town, opens her shop at five each morning. In 1998 she bought a second oven.

fields.source_text: Tom travelled from Warsaw to Gdansk by train. The journey took four hours and he read a novel on the way.
fields.summary: Tom took a four-hour train from Warsaw to Gdansk and read a novel.

fields.source_text: The team tested twelve samples. Nine samples passed and three failed because of contamination.
fields.summary: Of twelve samples tested, nine passed and three failed because of contamination.

match_clear_share.description: Share of the fragment's words a finding must contain to count as a clear match.

match_partial_share.description: Share above which a finding counts as a partial match.

match_min_word_length.description: Shorter words are ignored when comparing.

measures.name: False-positive rate
measures.description: Findings that are not errors, out of all findings.
